'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals Chris Twiss LS Wesa Gotta Grand Army''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Twiss]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wesa Gotta Grand Army|Theed-L-wesagottagrandarmy.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' WYS
* '''Username:''' vader322
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
